libs.note: BH-4632: the grace the BH-4552 scratch-closure lint (tests/lib/scratch-closure-lint.sh lint()) gives a suite raised by a PR head cut before the lint landed. Such a suite prints its findings as WARN plus one grace line and does not fail, until the head is rebased onto or merged with post-lint main, or the window below ends. Read through lane_knob in libs scope by scg_grace_days; tests/scratch-closure-lint-grace.bh-4632-test.sh drives it.

knobs.note: How many days the grace lasts, counted from the committer time of the commit that added tests/scratch-closure-lint.bh-4552-test.sh (found from git). 0 = off: every raised suite is red, as before BH-4632. A non-integer answer falls back to this default. The lib carries no literal of its own; with no harness root (a CI runner) the env, then this default, answers.
